impacts.statement: (2786 CFS), major flooding along the Jordan River between Utah Lake and the Jordan River Surplus Canal will affect roads, structures, and fields. Those owning structures along the river should take steps to alleviate major flood damage and inundation at this historical flow.

(2596 CFS), the Jordan River downstream Utah Lake to the Jordan River Surplus Canal will experience moderate flooding to structures, streets, and fields adjacent to the Jordan River. Those owning structures along the river should take steps to alleviate significant flood damage and inundation to property.

(2404 CFS), the Jordan River downstream of Utah Lake to the Jordan River Surplus Canal in Salt Lake County will experience minor flooding to structures, roads and fields. Flood damage will occur to basements, the Jordan River Parkway trail and underpasses, as well as parks along the river. Those owning structures along the river should take steps to alleviate flood damage.
